The Roos, led by first-year head coach [[Billy Donlon]], played their home games on-campus at [[Swinney Recreation Center]] in [[Kansas City, Missouri]] as a member of the [[Western Athletic Conference]] (WAC). The Roos finished the season 16–14, 8–7 in WAC play, to finish in fourth place. They were slated to be the fifth seed in the [[2020 WAC men's basketball tournament|WAC tournament]]; however, the event was canceled as the initial breakout of the [[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States|COVID-19 pandemic]] was commencing. This would be the Roos' last season as a member of the WAC, as they would rejoin the [[Summit League]] in July 2020 after a seven-year absence.{{Cite news|access-date=July 11, 2019|date=June 20, 2019|language=en|title=Kansas City Roo Athletics Rejoins Summit League|url=https://kcroos.com/news/2019/6/20/211805709.aspx|work=Kansas City Roos}} On July 1, 2019, the University of Missouri–Kansas City (UMKC) announced that its athletic program, formerly known as the UMKC Kangaroos, would officially be referred to as the [[Kansas City Roos]].{{cite press release|access-date=July 1, 2019|date=June 30, 2019|publisher=UMKC Kangaroos Athletics|title=UMKC Athletics Completes New Brand Identity|url=https://kcroos.com/news/2019/7/1/211806301}} == Previous season == The [[2018–19 UMKC Kangaroos men's basketball team|Roos]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] with a record of 11–21 overall, 6–10 in conference play, to finish in a tie for seventh place. ==Roster== {{CBB roster/Header |high_school = yes |sex = m |team = Kansas City Roos |teamcolors = y |year = 2019 }} {{CBB roster/Player | pos = F | num = 5 | first = Jordan | last = Giles | ft = 6 | in = 7 | lbs = 225 | class = Sr | high_school = [[Tennessee Christian Preparatory School|Tennessee Christian Preparatory]]/
